acc1.name: Knife roll
acc1.flavor: His. Eight knives, every edge shaving-sharp — 'a dull knife is a tired cook.' He fed the whole block out of a kitchen the size of a closet.

acc2.name: Notebook
acc2.flavor: Your handwriting, from when the routes still ran. Half schedules, half apocalypse patch notes. A magnum opus nobody asked for.

acc3.name: Dog Tags
acc3.flavor: Paloma Palmer, your friend: carried Enrique home once, no questions.

acc4.name: Seed packet
acc4.flavor: A packet of seeds, her handwriting on the front. Plant after last frost. As if frost were still the problem.
